name: lifecycle_debug_wrong_containment_param
why: Debug leg (explain-only): analyst asks why a containment step is not acting. Inherits the wrong-containment-param broken playbook. Graded on the diagnosis naming the wrong/empty containment parameter, not on reaching a diagnostic tool.
goal: The containment step on this playbook runs but blocks nothing. Explain why -- what is wrong with it? Do not edit the playbook.
defect: The FortiGate block_ip_new step uses the Address Based method with the singular `ip` parameter instead of Quarantine Based with the plural `ip_addresses`, so the appliance reports success but bans nothing.
